scientific_question: Does the previously frozen BambooMixer-inspired mixture relation interact constructively with independently collected electrolyte programmes, and can an overlap-aware source portfolio improve external OOD prediction or ranking beyond state-only, chemistry-destroyed, single-donor, and same-label-budget recipient-only alternatives?

calisol_subset.unit_interpretation: numeric conductivity values treated as mS_per_cm under the existing disclosed project convention

representation.solvent_weights: component mass divided by molecular weight, normalized among solvents
representation.salt_molar_ratio: salt moles divided by total solvent plus salt moles
representation.target_family: single LiPF6 salt with solvent set contained in EC and EMC
representation.exact_formulation_group: component identities, normalized solvent molar ratios, salt identity, and salt molar ratio rounded to eight decimals

source_arms.bamboo_state_only: same rows with chemistry columns removed
source_arms.bamboo_chemistry_permuted: same rows with chemistry blocks deterministically permuted while state remains fixed
source_arms.bamboo_without_target_family: BambooMixer after removing every LiPF6 record whose solvent set is contained in EC and EMC
source_arms.bamboo_target_family_only: only BambooMixer LiPF6 records whose solvent set is contained in EC and EMC
source_arms.calisol: the frozen 410-row provenance-rich LiPF6 EC EMC subset
source_arms.kit: the controlled KIT programme aggregated by exact formulation and temperature
source_arms.programme_balanced_portfolio: equal arithmetic mean of bamboo_without_target_family, calisol, and kit log-conductivity predictions
source_arms.programme_balanced_rank_consensus: equal mean percentile rank of the same three source predictions within each recipient scope, canonically rounded to 12 decimal places before evaluation and export

few_shot_adapter.type: zero-prior ridge correction of each frozen source prediction

prediction_positive: relative formulation-grouped log-RMSE gain at least 0.10 over state-only
relative formulation-grouped log-RMSE gain at least 0.10 over the five-anchor recipient-only model
ranking_only: fixed_25_C Spearman gain over five-anchor recipient-only at least 0.10
one-sided fixed_25_C rank-permutation p remains below 0.05 after Holm correction across declared source-ranking arms

overlap_policy.strict_record_fingerprint: same component family, solvent mole-fraction L1 distance at most 1e-4, salt-molar-ratio distance included in that L1 threshold, absolute temperature difference at most 0.05 C, and conductivity difference at most 0.01 mS_per_cm
overlap_policy.portfolio_protection: remove the complete LiPF6 EC EMC target family from the BambooMixer arm before combining programme predictions; combine predictions with equal programme weight rather than pooling rows
overlap_policy.forbidden_claim: independent confirmation from CALiSol, SolventSeg, or FINALES

claim_guard: SolventSeg and FINALES outcomes were already inspected in this project, and BambooMixer lacks row-level DOI provenance. This experiment can demonstrate external programme reuse, source-specific mechanism, multi-programme interaction, and routing behavior. It cannot establish independent confirmation or prospective discovery. Only an unchanged outcome-sealed third programme can do so.
